en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, slender minaret rising above low village houses and stone ruins in the foreground. The scene is printed with multilingual captions in Greek, French, and another Latin transcription identifying the place as the minaret of Yenidjé‑Vardar in picturesque Macedonia (Greece). The layout and style are typical of early 20th‑century touristic or documentary postcards.
